messages.subject: a couple of quick questions
parts:
1) Is it possible to _only_ plot the legend for a plot. Right now I am
plotting the plot without the legend by
p = ggplot(LONG CALL) + opts(legend.position = "none")
print(p)
but now I want to plot _only_ the legend in a separate display.

2) I am using facet_grid( A ~ B). In the case B has only 1 level, I do
not get a "column header" in a grey box. How do I get this? I can
place a title by using opts(title = "Something"), but I want the grey
box. This is important because I am subsequently placing several plots
together in one big structure and right now I have one (facetted) plot
without the grey bar on top.

Kasper

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: a couple of quick questions
parts:
> 1) Is it possible to _only_ plot the legend for a plot. Right now I am
> plotting the plot without the legend by
>   p = ggplot(LONG CALL) + opts(legend.position = "none")
>   print(p)
> but now I want to plot _only_ the legend in a separate display.

Yes:

qplot(mpg, wt, data=mtcars, colour=cyl) +
opts(keep = "legend_box")

But this is undocumented because it might change in the future.

> 2) I am using facet_grid( A ~ B). In the case B has only 1 level, I do
> not get a "column header" in a grey box. How do I get this? I can
> place a title by using opts(title = "Something"), but I want the grey
> box. This is important because I am subsequently placing several plots
> together in one big structure and right now I have one (facetted) plot
> without the grey bar on top.

Hmmm. There's no way to force inclusion at the moment, because
basically this case is treated the same as A ~ . I'll add it to my to
do list.

Hadley

(high-level comment): to me it makes sense to have both vertical and
horizontal strips for facet_grid(A ~ B). If I really have only one
level of say B and I do not want the strips, it seems to me that it
would be natural to use facet_wrap instead.

Now, I have tried adding a strip myself. First I add a title with the
relevant size

+ opts(legend.position = "none", title = "Diff",
plot.title = theme_text(size = 10))

All I need to do now is to add a rectangle around the title with the
right fill. I have come so far

grob <- ggplotGrob(p)
grob <- addGrob(grob, rectGrob(x = unit(0, "npc"), y = unit(1, "npc"),
width = unit(1, "npc"), height = unit(0.5,
"npc"),
gp = gpar(fill = "grey60", alpha = 0.2), name
= "titleBox"))
grid.draw(grob)

My questions now are
1) How do I make my new grob be drawn _before_ the plot title? (This
probably have something to do with the order of the children of the

2) How do I compute the relevant x,y, width, height of the rectangle I

panel, but I cannot figure out how to get that width and I also cannot
figure out the height and the (x,y) position of the rectangle.
